[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kenya_near_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Kenya to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC phase classifications and scenario projections were compiled for each month of 2021 and distributed as GeoJSON and KML files.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas
